asset_patch.figure_caption: Authentic soft-drinks scatterplot from MSET006 Q49, page 14; choices continue on page 15 and key is on page 16.

explanation: A. The original scatterplot decreases from about 455 thousand gallons at year 1 to a minimum near years 7–10, then rises to about 423 at year 16. This requires positive quadratic curvature and a positive intercept. Only A has both. Its vertex occurs at x = 38.44/(2×2.138) ≈ 8.99 with y ≈ 310.49; it predicts y(1) ≈ 446.97 and y(16) ≈ 415.56, consistent with the plotted trend. B and C predict negative initial values, and D curves downward and decreases for x ≥ 0. Independently verified; the printed MSET006 key also marks Q49 A.
